content: चित्य {%a.%} .²1 To be arranged in order or built up. .²2 Constructed upon a foundation (as fire). .{@-त्यम्@} .²1 The place at which a corpse is burnt. .²2 A monument. .{@-त्या@} .²1 A funeral pile. .²2 Piling up, building (as an altar).

चित्य {%a.%} Belonging to the funeral pyre; चित्यमाल्याङ्गरागश्च आयसाभरणोऽभवत् <ls>Rām. 1. 58. 11</ls>; {%m.%} funeral fire. {%f.%} .²1 A pyre. .²2 A piece of ground prepared for sacrifice; सचित्यो राजसिंहस्य संचितः कुशलैर्द्विजैः <ls>Rām. 1. 14. 29</ls>.
